best_practices.critical_rule: DO NOT write Node.js scripts. DO NOT use execute_command to run playwright. You have a Playwright MCP server with browser_* tools. Use them directly. Every browser interaction is a single MCP tool call, not a script.

principles.principle: Always call mcp--playwright--browser_snapshot before interacting with elements. The snapshot returns element refs you pass as "target" to mcp--playwright--browser_click, mcp--playwright--browser_type, etc. Without a snapshot, you cannot reliably target elements.

Call mcp--playwright--browser_take_screenshot after every interaction that changes page state. Use descriptive filenames: "01-baseline.png", "02-after-login.png", etc. Screenshots save to /home/celes/.local/share/playwright-mcp/ on the host.
Call mcp--playwright--browser_console_messages level="error" after navigation and major interactions. This catches JS errors, failed assertions, and runtime warnings.

Use mcp--playwright--browser_evaluate to run JS on the page for: - Extracting computed styles (colors, sizes, fonts) - Computing WCAG contrast ratios - Reading DOM state that isn't in the accessibility snapshot Pass a "function" string like: "() => { return document.title; }"
Call mcp--playwright--browser_network_requests after page loads and after form submissions to verify API calls succeeded (status 200) and responses are valid.
After clicking buttons that trigger async operations, use mcp--playwright--browser_wait_for with text="Success" or textGone="Loading" before taking the next screenshot.
Use mcp--playwright--browser_resize width=375 height=667 to test mobile layout. Take screenshots at mobile size, then resize back for desktop.

anti_patterns.never: Write a .js file and execute it with execute_command
Use execute_command with "thv mcp call" — call mcp--playwright--* tools directly
Use page.goto(), page.click(), or any raw Playwright Node.js API
Try to install playwright or check for browser binaries
Reference /home/node/ paths in evidence (use host paths)
Take a single screenshot at the end instead of per-step
Skip mcp--playwright--browser_snapshot and guess at CSS selectors
Use bare tool names like "browser_navigate" — always use "mcp--playwright--browser_navigate"
